title: BulsciCraft
description: Enjoy this brand new mod that adds New Dimensions, Mobs, Items, Blocks, Unusual things and even a bossfight...
body:
----- WELCOME TO  ![title!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fdd4e69362cb5e42c54ad3799ba4674a305670b.png)


----- 



What is Bulscicraft? Bulscicraft is a mod centered around, well, none other than BULSCI Himself! This mod adds 2 new Dimensions, Lots of mobs, MANY MANY New Items, Blocks and decorations.

 ----- CLOBOTOMY ---- 
 
 ![clobotomy pieces around the world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/579a67eb7ffd52383821a05146c27d05b2a2a980_0.webp)

This mod also adds.. well.. CLOBOTOMY IN THE GAME!!11!!!111 Clobotomy is a series of a gazillion videos on your screen, to put it in shorter terms, brainrot, but more powerful it actually drains your braincells, from the chaos! If you have epilepsy i reccomend you not doing the mod. 

----- CREDITS ---- 

Fucu99: Basically, everything Bulsci: The Description, and concept.

 ------- WHAT TO EXPECT FROM BULSCICRAFT ---- 

 ![items!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dc833ee8997e8390b5fb64c1251b76b21166db8.png)

Bulscicraft doesnt have just some items retextured.. no no no! Everything is fresh out of a clobotomy oven. Along your way, you might find alot of foes, new items, new blocks, and who could forget, NEW DIMENSIONS! To make an example, some mobs you could find along your way could be: Fat Bulsci, Bulsci Toe, Bulsci, and who could forget... #@?! Bulsci.. Wait.. why is it censored? Oh. its a mystery! Guess you will have to play it to find out ;)

WARNING: THIS MOD IS ONLY FOR MINECRAFT 1.21.4 NEOFORGE!
